Description=Roostack stirling-pdf: app

[Container]
ContainerName=roostack-stirling-pdf-app

[Service]

[Install]

==> caddy/sites/stirling-pdf.caddy
# Generated by Roostack for service "stirling-pdf". Do not edit: changes will be overwritten.

@stirling-pdf-web host pdf.lab.example.com
handle @stirling-pdf-web {
	vars {
		roostack_name stirling-pdf
		roostack_title "Stirling-PDF"
		roostack_private yes
	}
	@stirling-pdf-web-external not {
		remote_ip private_ranges 100.64.0.0/12 100.80.0.0/16 100.82.0.0/15 100.84.0.0/14 100.88.0.0/13 100.96.128.0/17 100.97.0.0/16 100.98.0.0/15 100.104.0.0/13 100.112.0.0/12
		not vars roostack_edge yes
	}
	abort @stirling-pdf-web-external
	request_body {
		max_size 100MB
	}
	route {
		request_header -Remote-User
		request_header -Remote-Email
		request_header -Remote-Name
		request_header -Remote-Groups
		handle /.roostack/sign-in/* {
			reverse_proxy 169.254.1.3:8482
		}
		forward_auth 169.254.1.3:8482 {
			uri /check?service=stirling-pdf
			copy_headers Remote-User Remote-Email Remote-Name Remote-Groups
		}
		reverse_proxy 169.254.1.3:20011 {
			header_up Cookie "roostack_sso=[^;]*;?[ ]*" ""
		}
	}
}
